name: cardiac_dirchange_v2_benchmark_v1
description: Direction-change troponin benchmark (v2) — nextlab format. Visible troponin trend reverses at target time; agent must use cross-lab gap signals to detect the reversal. Compatible with nextlab_answer_agent.js.

design.why_hard: Both last-value and trend-extrapolation heuristics fail by construction. Non-troponin labs (BNP, creatinine, etc.) during the gap window provide the signal needed to detect the reversal.
design.lab_timeline_note: lab_timeline includes all labs up to t_target EXCEPT troponin after t_visible. Rows with in_gap=True are from the gap window (t_visible < t <= t_target).
